suggestion.title: Smart Hydroponic Farm Operator
suggestion.desc: Establish a tech-driven hydroponic farm on a portion of the land, cultivating high-value crops with IoT-based monitoring and automation for optimal yield and resource efficiency.
suggestion.training: 6-12 months for setup and initial operations

suggestion.title: Polyhouse Cultivation of High-Value Crops
suggestion.desc: Establish and manage a polyhouse for cultivating high-demand, high-value crops like exotic vegetables (bell peppers, cherry tomatoes) or cut flowers for urban and export markets.
suggestion.training: 6-12 months for setup, technical training, and initial market establishment
